name: DEMO SEED — Engagement Data Reset v1.1

parameters.content:
### 🎬 DEMO SEED SCRIPT v1.1 — Engagement Data Reset

**Fix from v1.0:**
HubSpot native email fields (hs_email_open,
hs_email_click, hs_email_sends_since_last_engagement)
are READ ONLY — HubSpot calculates these internally.

This version writes directly to your own canonical
fields instead — fully writable, same end result.

**Fields written:**
• canon_engagement_score     (0-100)
• canon_engagement_status   (Active/At Risk/Cold/Dormant)
• canon_days_since_engagement
• canon_engagement_last_calculated

**Post-import wiring check (n8n import quirk):**
⚠ Verify SplitInBatches connections after import:
  loop output  → Update Contact
  done output  → Seed Complete

**How to use:**
1. Execute this workflow (Manual Trigger)
2. Wait ~15 seconds for all 20 contacts
3. Run /engagement-check in Slack
